findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: aws_s3_bucket s3-public is reachable without auth, which enables T1530 because the technique describes adversaries collecting data from cloud storage objects through direct APIs or misconfigured storage.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf public-read ACL maps to ATT&CK T1530 because unauthenticated internet principals can read objects in demo-public-bucket.

findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: aws_cloudtrail trail-main is disabled, which enables T1562.008 because the technique describes adversaries disabling or modifying cloud logging to limit the data collected on their activities and avoid detection.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_cloudtrail_disabled/input/main.tf disabled trail maps to ATT&CK T1562.008 because control-plane events are left without a durable audit record.

findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: aws_iam_policy iam-open grants Action=* on Resource=*, which enables T1078 because the technique describes adversaries obtaining and abusing credentials of existing accounts for initial access, persistence, privilege escalation, or defense evasion.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf wildcard identity policy maps to ATT&CK T1078 because an attached principal can act on every resource with the policy's unrestricted permissions.
